_about: Rows of data/youtube-playlist.tsv whose video is spoken in Russian although its title is in English. Nobody has listened to all of them (YouTube refuses every automated way of hearing a video); the build marks these "inferred" in public/data-youtube.json. Evidence: (1) the 29 sages whose Russian video has a Cyrillic title, where the Russian one is first in rows 59-188 (7 of 8 pairs) and second from row 657; (2) five pairs the owner listened to on 2026-10-12: Rashi (13/14), Rabbi Jacob Landau (169/170) and the Shach (420/421) have the Russian video FIRST; Rabbeinu Perachiah ben Nissim (248/249) and the Meshech Chochmah (600/601) have the English one first and the Russian one SECOND. So the order flips inside rows 189-656 and a single rule for that stretch would be wrong about half the time. Rows 1-188: the first of two adjacent English-titled rows is listed here as Russian. Rows 189-656: only the three pairs the owner checked are listed; the other pairs stay English until more of them are checked (see "unchecked_pairs"). A sage with three or more videos, or whose rows are not adjacent, is left as titled. If an upload turns out to be in the other language, move its row between this list and the sage's other row.
